scoring.answerRule: Award each selected answer the points listed for its player type.
scoring.normalizationRule: Divide each player type's points by all points earned, then multiply by 100.

questions.prompt: At the end of a long quest, what would make the night memorable?

answers.text: Retelling the best moments around a campfire
Finding a place no one in your party has seen

questions.prompt: You discover an unmarked door beneath the city. What draws you in?

answers.text: The mystery of what might be behind it
The chance to claim a rare reward inside

questions.prompt: A rival challenges you in the town square. What sounds best?

answers.text: A contest where everyone can see who wins
A friendly crowd cheering both of you on

questions.prompt: Your map has room for one more marker. What do you mark?

answers.text: A shortcut through a region you just uncovered
The location of a powerful piece of gear

questions.prompt: What would you most like other players to remember about you?

answers.text: That you were always there when they needed a friend
That no one could best you in a showdown

questions.prompt: You have an evening free in your favorite game. Where do you go?

answers.text: To a lively gathering where everyone knows your name
To the far edge of the map, just to see what’s there

questions.prompt: A new season begins. What gives you the biggest spark?

answers.text: A fresh challenge with a clear milestone to reach
A chance to test yourself against new rivals

questions.prompt: What makes a game world feel truly alive to you?

answers.text: The people who fill its streets and tell their stories
The places and secrets waiting beyond the road

questions.prompt: Your guild is deciding what to celebrate. Which feels right?

answers.text: A night spent together after a hard-won victory
A record-breaking feat that puts your guild on the map

questions.prompt: You find a hidden chamber filled with strange inscriptions. You…

answers.text: Stay to piece together what happened there
Look for a difficult challenge worth conquering

questions.prompt: Which kind of story would you rather be part of?

answers.text: A group of friends making their own traditions
A feud where every encounter raises the stakes

questions.prompt: A strange landmark appears on your compass. Your first thought?

answers.text: Who built it, and why is it out here?
What feat do I need to accomplish to reach it?

questions.prompt: What makes you feel most at home in an online world?

answers.text: A close-knit circle to laugh and adventure with
A worthy opponent who keeps you on your toes

questions.prompt: Which discovery would you tell your friends about first?

answers.text: A secret route through a familiar place
A personal best you worked hard to achieve

questions.prompt: At a busy crossroads, what catches your attention?

answers.text: A player looking for someone to join their journey
A tournament about to begin in the arena

questions.prompt: Which keeps you playing long after you meant to log off?

answers.text: One more conversation with the people you’ve met
One more stretch of the world left unexplored

questions.prompt: You can earn one title for your character. Which do you choose?

answers.text: A title that proves you mastered a hard challenge
A title earned by defeating a famous rival

questions.prompt: A friend asks what you love most about your current game.

answers.text: The friendships that have grown there
The unexpected things you keep discovering

questions.prompt: What kind of progress feels most satisfying?

answers.text: Understanding a place that once felt mysterious
Seeing your skill reflected in a new achievement

questions.prompt: Your team has one open spot. Who do you hope joins?

answers.text: Someone who makes every journey more fun
Someone eager to take on a fierce rival

questions.prompt: Which would you explore first in a newly opened region?

answers.text: The side paths that don’t appear on the main map
The challenges that award the rarest distinction

questions.prompt: A rival has beaten you once. What motivates you most?

answers.text: Learning the region better before your next encounter
Meeting them again and taking the win

questions.prompt: How do you like to spend time between major quests?

answers.text: Wandering somewhere you’ve never been
Improving a skill until you can do it flawlessly

questions.prompt: What would make a legendary duel worth remembering?

answers.text: Outsmarting a rival in a close, fair match
The strange, forgotten place where it took place

questions.prompt: What do you enjoy most about learning a new game?

answers.text: Finding the systems that reward careful practice
Seeing how other players react under pressure

questions.prompt: Which brag would you be prouder to share?

answers.text: A rare piece of gear you earned through persistence
A close match you won against a fierce challenger

questions.prompt: A difficult mission is finally complete. What next?

answers.text: Set a bigger goal and work toward it
Find another player ready for a contest

questions.prompt: Which reward would you choose for a season well played?

answers.text: A rank that shows how much you accomplished
A reputation that makes challengers think twice

questions.prompt: When you look back on a game, which moment stands out?

answers.text: The milestone you thought you’d never reach
The one-on-one match you still talk about

questions.prompt: What would you rather be known for in your favorite world?

answers.text: Always finishing what you set out to do
Never backing down from a worthy opponent
